# Text Humanize

> Text Humanize is a free web-based AI writing editor. It rewrites AI-assisted drafts so they read more naturally (varied sentence rhythm, less filler, plainer wording) while protecting numbers, names, links and citations. It also offers an AI writing-pattern checker and practical writing guides. No account is required.

Text Humanize does not guarantee any AI-detector outcome and is not designed to evade detection. Users are responsible for following academic and workplace rules on AI use.

## Tools
- [AI Humanizer](https://text-humanize.com/): rewrite text in five tones (Natural, Casual, Professional, Academic, Creative) with light, balanced or strong changes; up to 10,000 characters per request; word-level change comparison.
- [AI Detector](https://text-humanize.com/ai-detector): estimates how AI-like a text reads by combining writing-pattern checks with an open-source AI-detection model, and explains each signal. Scores are estimates, not proof of authorship.
- [How it works](https://text-humanize.com/how-it-works): technical explanation of the rewriting pipeline and its limitations.
